document.about: Herman Miller Aeron chair product sheet (2 pages). Page 2 sets product photos with numbered callouts beside columns of side-headed text.

notes: #203: page 2's labels are set in Söhne Halbfett (semibold) and Kräftig (medium), over body text in Buch. Halbfett was not read as a weight, and Kräftig only by its ink.

checks.issue: `Family`, set in Söhne Halbfett, was a paragraph, while its sibling labels were headings.
Kept: `Seat height`, set in Söhne Kräftig, a medium as heavy beside Buch as a semibold, stays a heading.
